virtualdevicesettings.labelButton1: Button 1 is special and remains the first, and therefore, the main device button and indicator.
virtualdevicesettings.labelGeneralOld: By Default, when using Insights or Tags, separate hidden fields will be created. This means you cannot see in the log who changed it. For buttons, you might not want this. But when disabled, changing the properties Icon, 'Show as' or 'Create Flow Cards' will causes Tag IDs to be changed and thus may break flows, and new Insights will be created.
virtualdevicesettings.labelAlso: Enabling all fields at once and pressing save, might be hard for Homey and could take a while.
virtualdevicesettings.labelCustomIcons: The custom icons can be set through the App Settings.
virtualdevicesettings.labelCamerasRestart: After removing a camera (by clearing the name or url), the Device Capabilities App requires a restart to remove the camera-image from the virtual device.
virtualdevicesettings.labelIcons: Here you will get a list with the names you have customized, once you have changed names in the App Settings.
virtualdevicesettings.field-not-set: __fieldId__ has not been set. Goto Device Settings and add the field.
virtualdevicesettings.labelStatusIndicator: Remember to set the status field as Status Indicator in the Mobile App.
virtualdevicesettings.hintClass: Changing the Device Class may break flows that depend on automaticly created flowcards of the previously specified class.
virtualdevicesettings.name: Name
virtualdevicesettings.decimalsHint: The number of decimals to show.
virtualdevicesettings.createSeparateCapabilitiesHint: When selected will create hidden fields for the Insights and Tag, which will not unlink when settings are changed. But it costs more resources.
virtualdevicesettings.createSeparateCapabilitiesTextHint: When selected will create a hidden field for the Tag, which will not unlink when settings are changed. But it costs more resources.
virtualdevicesettings.createSeparateCapabilitiesStatusHint:
When selected will create hidden fields for the Insights, Tag as Status Indicator field, which will not unlink when settings are changed.
But it costs double the resources.
virtualdevicesettings.createSeparateCapabilitiesBooleanHint:
When selected will create hidden fields for the Insights and Tag, which will not unlink when settings are changed.
But it costs more resources and you cannot know Who changed the value.
virtualdevicesettings.createSeparateCapabilitiesButtonHint:
When selected will create hidden fields for the Insights and Tag, which will not unlink when settings are changed.
But it costs more resources and you cannot know Who pushed the button.
virtualdevicesettings.createInsightsHint: When selected Insights will be created.
virtualdevicesettings.createTagHint: When selected a Tag will be created.
virtualdevicesettings.showAsTextHint: Select how the text must be displayed.

virtualdevicesettings.showAsBooleanHint: Select how the Yes/No must be displayed.
virtualdevicesettings.showAsButtonHint: Select how the button must be displayed.
virtualdevicesettings.createFlowCardsHint: When selected Default Flow Cards will be created for this capability.
virtualdevicesettings.unitsHint: The Units to use for the number. If you need Fahrenheit, enter °C and it will be translated into Fahrenheit.
virtualdevicesettings.hintEmptyDefault: When left empty, will be set to default.
virtualdevicesettings.minHint: The minimum value for the Number.
virtualdevicesettings.maxHint: The maximum value for the Number.
virtualdevicesettings.insightsTitleTrueHint: Insights Description for when the value is True.
virtualdevicesettings.insightsTitleFalseHint: Insights Description for when the value is False.
virtualdevicesettings.nonClickableHint: When selected this button will not be clickable. Requires a restart of the App after setting to Non-Clickable.
virtualdevicesettings.checkedHint: When selected this button will be light, else dark.
virtualdevicesettings.cameraUrlHint: The Url for Camera __i__. The Url has to be accessable through Homey's network.
virtualdevicesettings.cameraIntervalHint: The Interval in seconds to refresh the image for Camera __i__. Entering 0 will disable automatic refresh.
